page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8a.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9T24 processor running at 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the AMD EPYC processor demonstrates strong single-core performance, scoring 3072.68 in stress-ng single-core tests, placing it in the top 25 percent of tested instances. Multi-core CPU performance is moderate, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 49143.43. Memory bandwidth tests show average performance, yielding 2430.97 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 75.61 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. The processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, and AVX512_BF16, which accelerate vector calculations and machine learning inference tasks, alongside hardware-accelerated cryptography via AES and SHA_NI.

The instance offers a cost-efficient profile for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or dedicated GPU hardware. By providing a high density of RAM per vCPU, it minimizes the need to over-provision compute resources simply to acquire sufficient memory. This makes the instance highly suitable for enterprise databases, in-memory caching layers, data analytics, and memory-bound backend applications.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8a.8xlarge is a memory-optimized instance featuring 32 dedicated vCPUs and 256.0 GB of RAM, powered by an AMD EPYC 9T24 processor running at 2.7 GHz. Built on the KVM hypervisor, this x86_64 server provides 8.0 GB of memory per core but lacks local storage and GPU accelerators. It delivers strong single-core CPU performance alongside average multi-core and memory bandwidth capabilities. The processor supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and AVX512_VNNI for vector and neural network calculations. With a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps, this instance is designed for memory-intensive workloads, including in-memory databases, caching layers, and enterprise applications that require a high memory-to-vCPU ratio without the added cost of local storage.
